data.body_html:
Booking a Marbella yacht charter in 2030 is straightforward, but knowing which payment methods are accepted can save you time and stress. Whether you’re reserving the Astondoa 40 for a sunset cruise from Puerto Banús or the Mangusta 80 for a full-day adventure, we’ve structured our payment options to suit international clients, crypto enthusiasts, and cash users alike. Below, you’ll find every accepted method, deposit requirements, and what’s included in your charter — no surprises, just clear numbers.

Accepted Payment Methods Overview

We accept five main payment methods for all Marbella yacht charter bookings: bank transfer, credit/debit card, cryptocurrency, cash (EUR), and PayPal (for deposits only). Each method has its own processing time and limits, detailed in the table below. All prices include 21% Spanish IVA, skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks — no hidden fees.

MethodDeposit (50%)Final Balance (50%)Processing TimeSurcharge
Bank TransferYesYes1–5 business daysNone
Credit/Debit CardYesYesInstant0% (Visa/MC), 2.5% (Amex)
CryptocurrencyYesYes10–30 minutes1% network fee
Cash (EUR)NoYes (max €2,500)On departureNone
PayPalYes (max €500)NoInstant3.5%

Bank Transfer: The Standard for Large Charters

Bank transfer remains the most popular method for Marbella yacht charter payment methods 2030, especially for high-value bookings like the Ferretti 94 (€ price on request). You’ll receive a pro-forma invoice with our Spanish IBAN and SWIFT code within 1 hour of your enquiry via WhatsApp. Deposit of 50% secures your date; final balance due 7 days before departure. EU transfers clear in 1–2 days; non-EU in 3–5. No surcharge applies.

Credit & Debit Cards: Instant and Convenient

For smaller charters like the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or Azimut 39 (€2,299/8h), card payment via secure link is the fastest option. We accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. The link is sent to your email or WhatsApp; you can pay the deposit or full amount in one go. Amex carries a 2.5% surcharge; Visa and Mastercard have none. Confirmation is instant, and your booking is locked in immediately.

Cryptocurrency: Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT

Embracing digital finance, we accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT (ERC-20) for the full charter value. This is ideal for international clients who prefer crypto. The payment is processed via a third-party gateway at the live exchange rate. A 1% network fee applies. Deposit 50% in crypto to secure your Mangusta 80 (from €4,719/4h) or any other boat. The balance can also be paid in crypto up to 7 days before departure.

Cash on Departure: For Last-Minute Flexibility

Cash (EUR only) is accepted for the final balance on the day of departure, up to a maximum of €2,500 per booking. This is useful for topping up extras like jet skis or for last-minute bookings where bank transfer timing is tight. Deposits must still be paid in advance via bank transfer or card. A receipt is always provided. Cash is not accepted for deposits.

Deposit and Balance Schedule

All bookings follow a standard payment schedule: 50% deposit to confirm, 50% balance due 7 days before departure. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), that’s €374.50 deposit for the 2-hour trip. For Tier B boats (Mangusta 80, white or grey), the deposit is €2,359.50. For other boats like the Canados 86 or Fairline Targa, pricing is on request — we’ll send a custom invoice. Late payments may result in release of the booking.

What’s Included in Every Charter

No matter which payment method you choose, every Marbella yacht charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, Spanish IVA (21%), water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. For Tier B boats, a jet ski is included free of charge. There are no hidden fees — the price you see is the price you pay. Departures are from Puerto Banús, with options to cruise to Cabopino, Estepona, or Sotogrande.

How to Book and Pay

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred boat, date, and duration. We’ll reply within 30 minutes with availability and a payment link. Choose your method — bank transfer, card, crypto, or cash — and pay the 50% deposit. Once confirmed, you’ll receive a booking confirmation with all details. Final balance is due 7 days before departure. For last-minute bookings (within 7 days), full payment is required upfront.
